mentions.name: pg-restic
mentions.description: A small Docker container that backs up Postgres databases to S3, B2, or any S3-compatible storage using restic (and also works with restic's rest-server). It runs pg_dumpall on a cron schedule and streams the dump straight into a restic repository so nothing touches local disk, producing encrypted, deduplicated snapshots with retention policies and daily pruning. Failed dumps save no snapshot, and it ships pg_dumpall 18 so it can back up Postgres versions from 9.2 to 18.
mentions.problem: Existing backup images shipped older pg_dump versions that couldn't back up newer Postgres versions, and the author needed Postgres backups at both work and home.
